correctness.rationale: Rebuilt GP(10,2) adjacency (30 edges), checked distance-two pair count 60 and 12 pentagonal faces. Every edge lies on two faces and every distance-two pair on one, yielding S1+S2/2=1/4 sum_f (Q_f^2-5)>=-12, equality exactly two or three plus spins on every face. Each odd pentagon forces NN sum>=-3 (S1>=-18), while each of 20 neighbor triplets forces next-neighbor sum>=-1 (S2>=-20). The two positive linear combinations give piecewise lower envelope at r=1/2. Independently enumerated all 2^20=1,048,576 configurations via bit masks, checked critical balance 9250, low equality 250, high equality 720, and second moment 304/185 at r=1/2; finite exhaustive enumeration is complete for this finite graph. Distinguishes order of zero-field susceptibility derivative and T->0. No thermodynamic-limit assertion.
